metadata.scopeNote: A manually curated thin slice for testing the experiment framework; it is not the final 30–100 entity Phase 1 dataset.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A set equipped with a distance function that is nonnegative, symmetric, separates distinct points, and satisfies the triangle inequality.
entities.granularityNote: Treats the general structure as one concept; particular metrics remain instances rather than separate entities.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A set together with a collection of open subsets closed under arbitrary unions and finite intersections and containing the empty set and the whole set.
entities.granularityNote: Represents the abstract notion, not an individual topology placed on a particular set.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A topological space that locally resembles Euclidean space and usually satisfies separation and countability conditions.
entities.granularityNote: Kept separate from smooth and Riemannian manifolds to test whether added structure changes semantic neighborhoods.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A manifold whose coordinate charts have smooth transition maps, allowing derivatives and smooth functions to be defined intrinsically.
entities.granularityNote: Modeled as a distinct structured concept rather than as a facet on the general manifold entity.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A smooth manifold with a smoothly varying inner product on every tangent space, enabling lengths, angles, geodesics, and curvature.
entities.granularityNote: The metric structure is bundled with the manifold concept; individual Riemannian metrics are not sampled separately yet.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A continuous bijection between topological spaces whose inverse is also continuous, expressing topological equivalence.
entities.granularityNote: Represents both the kind of map and the induced equivalence criterion; this dual role is retained as a possible failure case.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A smooth bijection between smooth manifolds with a smooth inverse, expressing equivalence of smooth structures.
entities.granularityNote: Kept distinct from homeomorphism so models can be tested on closely related equivalence notions.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A vector space attached to a point of a smooth manifold that captures the possible tangent directions and first-order behavior there.
entities.granularityNote: Uses the general construction as an entity, while a tangent space at a specified point is treated as an instance.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A geometric quantity measuring how the Levi-Civita connection fails to return vectors unchanged around infinitesimal loops on a Riemannian manifold.
entities.granularityNote: Narrows the broad word curvature to Riemann curvature; scalar and Ricci curvature remain possible split entities.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A curve that parallel-transports its own tangent direction; locally it generalizes a straight line and can extremize length under suitable conditions.
entities.granularityNote: Combines affine and metric characterizations for this thin slice; their possible separation is recorded for later review.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: The group of based loops in a topological space modulo continuous deformation, with composition given by concatenating loops.
entities.granularityNote: The invariant is represented independently of the chosen space and base point, which are inputs or instances.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A space locally resembling a product of a base space and a fiber, while allowing the global pieces to be twisted together.
entities.granularityNote: Uses the general bundle notion; vector, principal, and tangent bundles are deferred split candidates.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A smoothly varying alternating multilinear covector field on a smooth manifold that can be integrated over oriented chains of matching dimension.
entities.granularityNote: All degrees are grouped under one concept; particular zero-forms and volume forms are not separate entities.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A theorem relating the integral of curvature over a surface, together with boundary terms when present, to the surface's Euler characteristic.
entities.granularityNote: Groups the closed-surface and boundary variants; higher-dimensional generalizations are outside this entity for now.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A theorem equating the integral of the exterior derivative of a differential form over an oriented manifold with the integral of the form over its boundary.
entities.granularityNote: Uses the generalized theorem as one entity while classical vector-calculus cases are treated as specializations.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A cohomology theory built from closed differential forms modulo exact forms on a smooth manifold, linking differential data with topology.
entities.granularityNote: Treats the construction and invariant together; the de Rham theorem could later become a separate theorem entity.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: The unique affine connection on a Riemannian manifold that preserves the metric and has zero torsion.
entities.granularityNote: Models the canonical connection as a structure; its existence and uniqueness theorem is not separately sampled.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A physical theory in which gravitation is described through the curvature of spacetime modeled by a Lorentzian manifold and related to matter by field equations.
entities.granularityNote: Represents the theory as a boundary object; spacetime, Einstein equations, and particular solutions remain possible splits.

entities.publicDefinitionEn: A class of physical field theories whose descriptions have local symmetry, commonly formulated using connections and curvature on principal bundles.
entities.granularityNote: Uses the broad theoretical family to probe the math-physics boundary; individual gauge groups and field theories are not yet split.
